page.overview:
Who is Ernie Prang?

Ernest "Ernie" Prang was a British wizard who was the driver of the Knight Bus in the late 20th century and the early 21st century.

Ernest Prang's origin is unknown. He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in his youth, and was a member of Gryffindor house. Eventually, he began driving the Knight Bus. He worked with Stan Shunpike, the conductor of the Knight Bus, who sometimes called Ernie by his nickname, Ern.

Harry Potter first encountered Prang in 1993, when he was picked up by the Knight Bus after leaving his Aunt and Uncle's house. When Harry was taken to the Leaky Cauldron Ernie followed him in and was forced to leave by Cornelius Fudge, the then-Minister of Magic. Ernie was later present at the funeral of Albus Dumbledore in early July 1997.

In the early 2010s, an unusual event involving the Knight Bus was reported by the Daily Prophet. On the night of 25 October, the bus was speeding through London when Prang spotted a shiny pumpkin in the road. After stopping to investigate, Shunpike, the conductor, found nothing out of the ordinary, so they continued on their route. However, as they drove on, hundreds of pumpkins suddenly appeared, bouncing and trailing behind the bus. These pumpkins vanished as the bus approached Northampton. Shortly after, Ernie turned to find Stan's head covered by a large carved pumpkin on his head, glowing green. Ernie quickly dispelled the pumpkin, but upon checking the bus, he discovered that every passenger had disappeared, leaving only a single pumpkin on each bed.
